nasm.name: NASM
nasm.basis: Professional fitness education and certification organization; official exercise pages and credited NASM channel.
nasm.limitations: Publisher authority does not validate every variation or resolve inconsistencies in an individual page.

puregym.name: PureGym
puregym.basis: Gym operator publishing its own trainer exercise demonstrations and technique guides.
puregym.limitations: Commercial training guidance. Some written pages have known errors retained in the technique library; multiple videos on a page can show different variants.

physitrack.name: Physitrack
physitrack.basis: Clinical exercise-prescription publisher; describes expert-created, professionally narrated demonstrations. Provider metadata credits Physitrack.
physitrack.limitations: Library landing-page card labels can disagree with the linked video. Thirteen mismatched pairs were excluded. Clinical-library provenance is not an individual prescription.

rehabhero.name: Rehab Hero
rehabhero.basis: Clinician-led exercise library. Primary biography identifies David Song as a chiropractor and strength coach; selected embedded clips credit Rehab Hero.
rehabhero.limitations: Biography is publisher-reported, not a license audit. Do not assume every unnamed model or contributor is the clinician. One mislabeled embedded clip was excluded; identical article titles can refer to different postures.

ms.name: Muscle & Strength
ms.basis: Established exercise editorial publisher; selected original demonstrations are credited to its own channel and linked from exercise-specific instruction pages.
ms.limitations: Supplementary strength instruction. The selected pages do not establish the individual demonstrator credentials; some prose is inconsistent. No clinical authority inferred.

strongfirst.name: StrongFirst
strongfirst.basis: Strength education organization and original kettlebell coaching demonstrations. Windmill article identifies Brett Jones and his training qualifications.
strongfirst.limitations: Method-specific coaching choices; a title match is not evidence that every catalog variation or progression is shown.

trx.name: TRX
trx.basis: Equipment manufacturer and official training channel.
trx.limitations: Manufacturer expertise applies to its equipment; model-specific setup remains relevant. Compilation videos can contain multiple exercises.

hk.name: Human Kinetics
hk.basis: Original sport and exercise textbook publisher with attributed instructional videos.
hk.limitations: Some library items require subscription. Selected public YouTube metadata was checked; full playback was not inspected.

onnit.name: Onnit
onnit.basis: Equipment and coaching publisher; named original demonstrations include Shane Heins and Aaron Guyett.
onnit.limitations: Commercial coaching reference. Kneeling, seated and in-and-out rope patterns must not be treated as standing or rotational variants.

gentilcore.name: Tony Gentilcore / Testosterone Nation
gentilcore.basis: Named strength coach original TRX anti-rotation article; embedded clip credited to Testosterone Nation rather than the article author channel.
gentilcore.limitations: Written setup was reviewed separately. Full video motion remains unreviewed; creator and host publisher are preserved separately.

steph.name: Steph Gaudreau
steph.basis: Strength coach primary biography lists NASM-CPT and sports-nutrition credentials; selected clip credits her Fuel Your Strength channel.
steph.limitations: Publisher-reported credentials; no independent credential renewal check or full playback review.

e3.name: E3 Rehab
e3.basis: Clinician education company founded by doctors of physical therapy; original exercise articles and credited E3 Rehab channel.
e3.limitations: Rehabilitation context is not a prescription for app members. The pogo section start time comes from the article link, not observed playback.

atg.name: ATG / Ben Patrick
atg.basis: Original coach and author of the Knee Ability Zero tibialis-raise method; primary coaching reference and credited The Kneesovertoesguy channel.
atg.limitations: Coaching-method reference, not medical authority or evidence for broader injury-prevention claims.

bosu.name: BOSU
bosu.basis: Equipment manufacturer official named exercise demonstration.
bosu.limitations: Pulse squat-jump variation is related only to a generic BOSU squat jump; surface orientation and transitions need comparison.

crossfit.name: CrossFit
crossfit.basis: Original strength-and-conditioning education publisher and credited official channel.
crossfit.limitations: Sandbag demonstration only; no general endorsement of programming or individual suitability.

rogue.name: Rogue Fitness
rogue.basis: Equipment manufacturer original movement demonstration; provider description identifies athlete Matt Chan.
rogue.limitations: Forward/backward drags are related to sled pulling; waist-harness and hand-over-hand rope versions differ. Direct page fetch was blocked, but indexed publisher page and official clip identity were checked.

qld.name: Health and Wellbeing Queensland
qld.basis: Queensland public-health agency publishing its own exercise image and video.
qld.limitations: Elevated desk support differs from a floor scapular push-up.

concept2.name: Concept2
concept2.basis: Rowing-machine manufacturer original technique demonstration and guidance.
concept2.limitations: Manufacturer technique reference; machine setup and individual adjustments still require comparison.

squatu.name: Squat University
squatu.basis: Aaron Horschig primary biography identifies a doctorate in physical therapy and strength/coaching background.
squatu.limitations: Selected still identifies a movement starting posture only; not a complete observed hip-airplane sequence.

aaos.name: AAOS OrthoInfo
aaos.basis: American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons patient exercise illustrations.
aaos.limitations: Cross-body shoulder figure only; medical rehabilitation context is not an individual prescription.
